lead.headline: Gordon is still benched on Friday
lead.deck: 2-5. Swap Gordon into the flex for Metcalf before Sunday 12:00, and make sure the Coker claim is in.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. At 13:05 UTC DK Metcalf is still in the flex and Ollie Gordon II is still on the bench — the same 2.2 projected points three briefs have flagged. Thursday's reports change nothing: neither is listed, and Jaylen Wright's full practice is already in Gordon's number. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, caught a fourth-down touchdown at Green Bay on Thursday night for nobody; he sits on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00. Everyone else AVIATO starts was off Thursday's reports, Kyler Murray throws to Jefferson and Hockenson at Detroit, the softest tight-end defence in the league, and Allen plays in the week's highest total.

players.caption: Gordon — still on the bench; the flex by projection
Metcalf — in the flex as set; bench him

doFirst.headline: A swap before Sunday, a claim before Wednesday
doFirst.deck: Gordon over Metcalf in the flex; Coker back for Fairbairn.
doFirst.note: Chem priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting — but AVIATO are 10th, so a rival can take him first.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide before Sunday.
